subject: Assurance rotation plan — multi-year SOC2/ISO engagement options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: procurement@auditech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:12:00Z
Subject: RFP: multi-year SOC2/ISO audit options and rotation plan

Hi Elena / Auditech team,

We're updating our assurance strategy for the next three years and want to evaluate two options in parallel: a 3-year retainer with predictable pricing, and a rotational model where we rotate primary assurance providers every 18 months to broaden coverage. Please see the attached RFP (Redwood_Assurance_RFP_2027.pdf) for scope, evidence transfer expectations, and our preferred timeline (SOC2 recert in Q3).

Key asks up front:
- High-level pricing for both models (annual and multi-year commit)
- Sample SLA for audit turnaround and remediation windows
- References for ISO and SOC2 engagements with similar scale (100M+ monthly tokens, hybrid cloud)
- Any standard exclusions you expect to carve out

We'd like a short proposal by EOD 2027-04-26 and are scheduling a 45-minute kickoff call the week of May 3 — please share availability.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Assurance_RFP_2027.pdf
From: Elena Korhonen <elena.k@auditech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@auditech.com
Date: 2027-04-23T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP: multi-year SOC2/ISO audit options and rotation plan

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the RFP and the clear timeline. We can absolutely provide both a 3-year retainer option and a rotational proposal. Quick clarifying questions before we finalize a draft:

1) For the rotational model, do you expect Auditech to be the primary for months 0-18 and then step down, or would you prefer Auditech and a partner to run overlapping artifacts during the handoff?
2) For evidence transfer, do you prefer a secure S3 bucket with short-lived URLs or direct access to a read-only connector?
3) Any non-negotiable SLAs (e.g., maximum 5 business days for interim testing response) we should price to?

We will attach a preliminary proposal (auditech-proposal-04127.pdf) and a summary pricing matrix by Monday, 2027-04-26.

Best regards,
Elena Korhonen
Director, Assurance Services
Auditech LLP

Attachment: auditech-proposal-04127.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP: multi-year SOC2/ISO audit options and rotation plan

Jonas — copied the legal and procurement lanes into my initial read. High-level notes after scoring the first-round proposals (see vendor_scorecard.xlsx):

- Auditech: strong ISO practice, clear scope, competitive deskside rates. Proposal assumes a single-year rate uplift at +4% year 2 and +4% year 3.
- Concerns: evidence access model is S3-only (we prefer connector), and SLAs are soft on interim testing.
- Rotation considerations: cost of dual-engagement during handoff estimated at ~0.7x annual audit cost for the overlap year; benefits are cross-validation and vendor risk reduction.

Recommendation options for leadership:
A) 3-year retainer with guaranteed pricing caps if Auditech provides connector access and 15% volume discount on multi-year commit.
B) 18-month rotation pilot (Auditech lead + partner shadow) with explicit handoff playbook and vendor split PO.

Asking for your guidance on the tradeoff between predictability (A) and resilience (B). I flagged commercial items for negotiations in the scorecard.

--Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_scorecard.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Korhonen <elena.k@auditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:28:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP: multi-year SOC2/ISO audit options and rotation plan

Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed the preliminary proposal internally. A few negotiation points before the kickoff call:

1) Multi-year pricing: Redwood is prepared to sign a 3-year retainer if Auditech can offer a capped annual increase (<=3%) and a 15% aggregate discount off list rates for the commitment.
2) Evidence access: must support a read-only connector (preferred) or signed S3 pattern with short-lived creds — connector strongly preferred.
3) SLAs & remediation: need a commitment to 5 business days for interim requests and a defined remediation verification window (30 days typical).
4) Rotation flexibility: if we choose rotation, we need an explicit handoff playbook and vendor-to-vendor knowledge transfer timeline in the SOW.

I've attached a brief negotiation letter (negotiation-ltr.docx) that outlines those asks and key PO terms. Please confirm whether Auditech can accommodate the multi-year cap + connector and provide a revised commercial by 2027-04-28 so we can align Legal for signoff.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
VP, Security & Compliance

Attachment: negotiation-ltr.docx
From: Elena Korhonen <elena.k@auditech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@auditech.com, procurement@auditech.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP: multi-year SOC2/ISO audit options and rotation plan

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear asks and the negotiation letter. Good news: Auditech can support a read-only connector integration and will hold annual increases to <=3% for a 3-year commitment. We can offer a 15% aggregate discount if the agreement is executed as a retainer by 2027-05-15.

For rotation: we propose a handoff playbook with a 60-day overlap (shadowing + joint evidence review) and a knowledge-transfer checklist; pricing for the overlap will be capped at 0.6x of the annual audit fee.

We are preparing a redline of the SOW and commercial terms now and will route a DocuSign envelope to the Redwood Legal contact by EOD 2027-04-28 (link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?token=env-abc123-audit). Please confirm the PO owner and preferred billing cadence.
